related.title: 超級電容模組均衡設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「電廠的總能量與時長」與「待機損失的時間常數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；超級電容模組均衡設計的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Total energy and duration of the plant" and "Time constant of standby loss" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Supercapacitor Module Balancing Design must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦懸浮在真空裡的高速轉子：動能、可用轉速範圍、輪緣應力、磁浮承載、待機損失與爆裂能量；超級電容模組均衡設計則以幾秒鐘的儲能：電容儲能、可用電壓範圍、串聯不均、被動均衡、最大功率與時間常數為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A fast rotor levitated in vacuum: kinetic energy, usable speed range, rim stress, magnetic lift, standby loss and burst energy; Supercapacitor Module Balancing Design centres on storage for seconds: capacitor energy, usable voltage range, series imbalance, passive balancing, peak power and time constant, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「飛輪動能」與「儲存的能量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「輪緣的周向應力」的模型移到超級電容模組均衡設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「最大輸出功率」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Flywheel kinetic energy" and "Energy stored".
Move the model of "Hoop stress in the rim" to Supercapacitor Module Balancing Design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Peak output power", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「電廠的總能量與時長」與「待機損失的時間常數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；超級電容模組均衡設計的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Total energy and duration of the plant" and "Time constant of standby loss" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Supercapacitor Module Balancing Design must be respecified.

related.title: 重力儲能吊升與制動系統
related.titleEn: Gravity Storage Hoisting and Braking Systems
related.transfer: 可遷移「電廠的總能量與時長」與「待機損失的時間常數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；重力儲能吊升與制動系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Total energy and duration of the plant" and "Time constant of standby loss" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Gravity Storage Hoisting and Braking Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦懸浮在真空裡的高速轉子：動能、可用轉速範圍、輪緣應力、磁浮承載、待機損失與爆裂能量；重力儲能吊升與制動系統則以把重物舉高來存電：位能、所需質量、提升功率、效率鏈、鋼索、煞車與隱含碳為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A fast rotor levitated in vacuum: kinetic energy, usable speed range, rim stress, magnetic lift, standby loss and burst energy; Gravity Storage Hoisting and Braking Systems centres on storing power by lifting weights: potential energy, mass needed, hoisting power, the efficiency chain, ropes, brakes and embodied carbon, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「飛輪動能」與「單一重塊的儲能」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「輪緣的周向應力」的模型移到重力儲能吊升與制動系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「駐車煞車的保持扭矩」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Flywheel kinetic energy" and "Energy stored in one block".
Move the model of "Hoop stress in the rim" to Gravity Storage Hoisting and Braking Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Holding torque of the parking brake", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「電廠的總能量與時長」與「待機損失的時間常數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；重力儲能吊升與制動系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Total energy and duration of the plant" and "Time constant of standby loss" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Gravity Storage Hoisting and Braking Systems must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 飛輪儲能磁軸承系統
history.titleEn: Flywheel Energy Storage Magnetic Bearing Systems
history.text: 2008 年1 MW 的示範系統開始為電網調頻；2011 年史蒂芬鎮 20 MW 電廠啟用；2014 年賓州的第二座 20 MW 電廠啟用。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2008: A 1 MW demonstration began regulating grid frequency. 2011: The 20 MW Stephentown plant opened. 2014: A second 20 MW plant opened in Pennsylvania. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
